original_card.first_experiment: State one missing boundary lemma in full before starting a proof-assistant build.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Phase-sharp pre-wrapper uniqueness extending factor_iff_pre from lambda 1 to an invertible scalar, bound to the three certified Exact.lean pairs
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one scoped interface lemma. factor_iff_post is already stated in research/hpe-post-wrapper-lemma. This package takes the pre-side scalar extension that lemma explicitly does not claim, which is still the lambda=1 theorem in Labels.lean.
bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can narrow the conditional gap without changing kappa. factor_iff_pre fixes only the unscaled pre-wrapper; the phase field is the remaining monomial freedom on that side of (N).
stop_rule: Stop after this one pre-wrapper lemma, its equational replay and the three certified pairs. No second lemma, no Lean build, no supplier or kappa claim.
evidence: Equational replay over Q(i) at sizes 2 and 3 for five scalars, with invertible failure shifts and one singular-C control. Exact Z[i] circuits on pair1-3: shipped and dead-bit pre-wrappers hold only at lambda 1; three phase shifts hold only at i^{-t}; four non-phase pre-wrappers miss all four roots of unity; C8 is rejected. Self-test rejects a phase-shifted shipped pre-wrapper as lambda 1.

ai_assistance: Substantial Cursor Grok 4.7 assistance in the statement, verifier and write-up. No independent human review.
